title: kb-worker names the open choices that need a gate and lists every consumer of a changed function before it changes it
goal: kb-worker.md tells a worker that a default, a width, an opt-in, a limit or a price it picks is a choice the goal leaves open (a provisional gate), and that a change to what a function returns or takes runs backlog.py referrers on it and covers every consumer in the same item; SP-2vhfsn4o: the orchestrator recorded three ungated choices (ST-vua43tob opt-in, ST-fuflyzxc pack width, BG-jj2nc5ou output count), and two consumers were missed and filed as bugs (BG-3h4g5jdc after ST-x333wyrc, BG-ovvvqtxf after BG-jj2nc5ou). Rule 6 and the brief's matching rule (bl_dispatch.py WORKER_RULES) also say: a choice named in the report and recorded as no gate on work/<id> sends the item back; an item whose touches are rule-guarding gets its choice as a blocking gate, and a worker whose gate add prints 'made blocking' commits it and stops with a report.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_dispatch as d;w=open(".claude/agents/kb-worker.md",encoding="utf-8").read();a="backlog.py referrers" in w and "made blocking" in w;b=any("referrers" in r for r in d.WORKER_RULES);print("kb-worker names referrers and made blocking:",a,"; brief rule names referrers:",b);sys.exit(0 if a and b else 1)

gates.question: Does the dispatch brief relax stop on a blocking gate, so an operator pre-asks the rule-guarding choices and a worker records any further choice as a gate with its recommendation applied and goes on?
options: keep: a blocking gate stops the worker, which reports
relax: a further choice is a gate with its recommendation applied and the work goes on
gates.recommendation: keep: a blocking gate stops the worker, which reports
gates.answer: keep: a blocking gate stops the worker, which reports
